title: The Lens (observer drop)
description: Alternative primary motif for contemplative videos: a glassy drop that rests at motif-home and emits ripple rings when its idea is named. Use INSTEAD of the thread, never alongside it.

do: Ripple exactly when the idea is named (pair with sfx.ripple-ping)
dont: Use with motif.thread in the same video

provenance.author: MAI style system (Claude Code session)
provenance.reference: Glass drop motif in Philosophy of Everything 'Who are you?'
